title: Concept: Set-Cookie Domain is an IP address
description: A Domain attribute set to an address literal is a deployment artefact: the value was templated from the request host at a point where the host was an IP. The browser then refuses the cookie for the real host name, and the symptom is a login that works on one address and not on another.
applicability: Responses from deployments that template the cookie domain from the request host.
risk: The session cookie is silently dropped, so users on the canonical host name lose their session and are pushed toward the address-literal host.
